report:
# Eratosthenes round2 adopted-source verification, 2026-10-28

Adopted frozen header: `adopted_frozen.hpp`, SHA-256 `1b131dd83e7c1100d39a599d2e414541858907eb43ba6c8a4be245e498c7c166`. Its complete bytes equal the installed `Math/Eratosthenes.cpp`. This version contains the new AVX2 carry-save counting and conditional portable rotate-based striking. It has no medium-size prime-enumeration helper. The earlier77c9 and3ffc tests are retained separately and are not relabeled as adopted-source tests. This validation task did not edit repository files.

All24 adopted-source configurations passed:

- Twelve C++23 matrix configurations: GCC15.2 and Clang21.1.8 × checked/skip × `-O2`, `-O2 -DSIRKIT_DISABLE_SIMD`, `-O1` ASan+UBSan.
- Eight supplemental native configurations: GCC/Clang × checked/skip × SIMD enabled/disabled, `-O2 -march=native`.
- Four independent allocation-failure configurations: GCC/Clang × checked/skip, `-O2` without sanitizer allocation interceptors. Each reports12 checks and0 live allocations.

Builds run on CPU10 and functional execution on CPU2. Compiler warnings and runtime stderr are empty. Matrix `-MMD` files name adopted_frozen.hpp and readelf `.comment` records the actual compiler. Time measurements are functional-test durations, not performance claims. ASan/UBSan use `detect_leaks=0:halt_on_error=1` and `halt_on_error=1:print_stacktrace=1`. LeakSanitizer was not run.

The independent oracle uses one byte per integer in a full-integer elementary sieve through4,200,000. It does not share the library's odd-only bit layout, presieve patterns or blocked marking. The expanded suite covers514 boundary limits and4,879,334 `is_prime` comparisons. Each checked/SIMD-enabled run reports4,889,586 new assertions; skip/SIMD-enabled4,889,072. SIMD-disabled builds omit4896 direct helper checks and report4,884,690/4,884,176 respectively.

Boundary limits include every0..255 value, the16384 existing enumeration-path switch,255/256/257-word popcount boundaries and nearby final bits, blocked-build limit262144, odd-block boundaries524288 through4194304, the1155-word presieve period, prime squares3..2039, and20 deterministic random limits. Limits262144 and4194304 compare every integer; all limits compare complete ascending enumeration, count, prefix-preserving append and callbacks. Wrapper overloads and copy/move/self-assignment/moved-from reuse/independent ownership are included.

General enumeration checks also cover ±3 around1742537 and1742539, the independent oracle's131072nd and131073rd primes. The test output retains the historical label `MEDIUM_BOUNDARY` for these values. They are test data only: the adopted implementation has no131072-prime switch or medium collection helper.

AVX2 carry-save and wrapper functions are each checked directly on six data patterns: zero, all ones, alternating bits, moving single bit, descending density and deterministic random. There are four unaligned offsets. Word counts cover0/1/2/3/4/5/7/8/15/16/31/32 plus ±4 around64/128/192/256/320/384/512/1024/4096/65536. Direct checks test carry propagation across many64-word blocks and all scalar/vector remainders;4896 comparisons pass.

The previous repository SIMD test is included as a second suite and reports675840,675360,674786 or674306 successful assertions depending on checked/SIMD settings. Its local copied `main` has a harness-only explicit `return 0` before macro-renaming, preventing fallthrough from a renamed ordinary function. The repository test remains unchanged. Existing cases also cover callback exceptions and known independent prime counts at10M/100M.

GCC default builds have neither `__BMI2__` nor `__AVX2__`, so they execute the new portable `std::rotl` striking path. GCC native has BMI2 and uses the existing4-unroll path. Clang always uses the existing striking path. Native/standard configurations also cover compiler auto-vectorized scalar fallback counting. Actual macro results are preserved in `candidate_tests/adopted1b/conditional-macros.json`; the compiler options match those used to record the macros for the previous frozen header.

All eight SIMD-disabled default/native executable symbol tables have neither CPU dispatch (`__cpu_`) nor the added AVX2/carry-save helper symbols. Standard fallback correctness is independently checked rather than inferred from enabled builds.

Primary adopted-source evidence:

- `candidate_tests/extended.cpp`: independent enhanced test source, SHA-256 `1ee0cd8f2e150905c8ef16bbe97ab28956900c414d5de42f00f12d071deb26d4`.
- `candidate_tests/existing_simd_test.cpp`: local adapted existing test.
- `candidate_tests/allocation_test.cpp`: unchanged copied allocation test.
- `candidate_tests/adopted1b/results.json`, `allocation.json`, `hashes.json`.
- `candidate_tests/adopted1b_native/results.json`.
- `candidate_tests/adopted1b/fallback-symbol-proof.json`, `conditional-macros.json`.
- Per-configuration build/dependency/comment/run logs alongside the matrix JSON.

Baseline results remain under `baseline/`. Earlier3ffc intermediate results remain under `candidate_tests/final/` and `candidate_tests/native/`. Earlier77c9 results remain under `candidate_tests/final77/` and `candidate_tests/final77_native/`, with `FINAL_REPORT77.md`. None of those records are reused as the adopted-source matrix.
